title: PD Gait Response Calculator: analysis code and web calculator for predicting gait-speed improvement after training in Parkinson's disease
description: Analysis code (IMU gait-parameter and wavelet packet decomposition feature extraction, model training with nested LOOCV and 5-fold cross-validation, SHAP explainability and a sensitivity analysis) and an interactive web calculator accompanying the article 'Predicting Gait Rehabilitation Response in Parkinson's Disease Using Clinical and Wearable-Derived Gait Measures: A Preliminary Study'. Research use only; not validated for individual clinical decision-making.
